1. Case overview

Summary. 8 plans were evaluated: 7 DMAT variants and 1 reference plan.

Clinical background and rationale. Unilateral head-and-neck targets prescribed 70 and 54 Gy in 35 fractions. The comparison examines high-dose target coverage, parotid dose and cord-PRV exposure.

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. DMAT: 6FFF; 1 arc; modulation −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: VMAT_TB — 6FFF, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. The DMAT source reports contained 28 provided goals per plan, with priority identifiers, goal thresholds and acceptable-variation fields. Derived and automatic objectives were listed separately. For DMAT -3, examples were PTV_70Gy V70.00 Gy ≥ 98.0 % (P1.3); Parotid_L Dmean ≤ 2.00 Gy (P1.2).

Comparison methods. Dose colorwash, DVHs, individual endpoint–time plots and the saved 31-endpoint scorecard were compared. All saved dose factors were 1.0; no additional rescaling was applied. Scores summarize the selected endpoints. DMAT timing came from matched metrics; reference timing used an RT Plan control-point estimate.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice. Slice positions are synchronized across plans.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
15 GySIB 54 GySIB 70 Gy78.5 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DMAT 0’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 15–78.5 Gy color scale.
